behavior_items: The reproducer defines a `static` item named `foo` inside `main`, with the declared type `dyn Fn() -> u32`. This intentionally uses a trait object type directly as the type of a static variable, without any indirection such as `&'static dyn Fn() -> u32` or `Box<dyn Fn() -> u32>`.

`dyn Fn() -> u32` is a dynamically sized type (DST). Trait objects do not have a compile-time known size, so they cannot be used directly in places that require a `Sized` type. A `static` item allocates storage with a fixed layout, so the compiler must reject an unsized trait object stored by value. This is why the code expects an error like "the size for values of type ... cannot be known at compilation time".

The initializer is a closure, `|| -> u32 { ...; 0 }`. Closures in Rust have unique anonymous concrete types, and non-capturing closures can implement the `Fn` family of traits. The code relies on coercion from the concrete closure type to a `dyn Fn() -> u32` trait object, exercising closure-to-trait-object coercion rules.

The closure body contains `...`, the deprecated/experimental expression syntax sometimes called the "ellipsis expression". Historically this syntax has been used as a placeholder or marker for unimplemented code paths and is rejected on stable Rust; on nightly it still exercises parser/type-checker handling for this special expression form. Its presence helps stress compiler diagnostics in a closure body that is itself part of a failing static initialization.

Because the item is a `static`, Rust also requires the type to be usable in a global shared context. Shared statics must have a type that is `Sync`, since they may be accessed from multiple threads. A plain `dyn Fn() -> u32` trait object does not automatically imply `Sync`; the object would need a bound such as `dyn Fn() -> u32 + Sync`. This explains the expected diagnostic about "cannot be shared between threads safely".

The reproducer therefore combines multiple compiler checks on a single declaration: unsized-type rejection for statics, trait-object auto-trait checking for `Sync`, closure coercion to `dyn Fn`, and parsing/type-checking of the `...` expression inside the initializer.

Placing the `static` inside `main` is also relevant: Rust permits local `static` items, but they are still true statics with the same compile-time storage and thread-safety requirements as module-level statics. The reproducer ensures the bug is about item semantics rather than top-level module structure.

The expected multiple errors on the marked line indicate the test is likely checking how rustc reports overlapping issues from the same construct. In particular, the compiler must diagnose both representation/layout problems (`dyn Fn` is unsized) and global-sharing constraints (`Sync` for static items), instead of crashing or missing one of them.

Returns whether an `if` expression is specifically the `else if` branch of a parent `if` expression by checking the parent HIR node. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Evaluates whether a type mismatch should be addressed with an explicit cast, while suppressing noisy or misleading suggestions for cases like imported spans, shorthand field confusion, conversion constructors such as `T::from(...)`, and const-context restrictions. Detects accidental method-call syntax written across a range literal, such as using `a..foo()` where `a.foo()` was likely intended, and suggests replacing the range operator with method-call syntax after confirming the start expression supports the method. When a unit-typed local binding refers to a block with no tail expression, checks whether the final semicolon-terminated statement already has the expected type and suggests removing that semicolon; otherwise it labels the block as missing a tail expression. Returns the stored `LocalDefId`; it does not call other listed methods.

Finalizes dependency-graph encoding by calling `dep_graph.finish_encoding` with the profiling session.

Returns codegen attributes for body-like definitions by first calling `TyCtxt::def_kind`; if that kind supports codegen attrs it calls `TyCtxt::codegen_fn_attrs`, otherwise it returns the empty attrs for const-like kinds or bugs on unexpected kinds.
Arena-allocates a stealable THIR wrapper by calling `Steal::new` and then `arena.alloc`.
Arena-allocates a stealable MIR body wrapper by calling `Steal::new` and then `arena.alloc`.

Reads `rustc_layout_scalar_valid_range_{start,end}` attributes for a definition by calling `TyCtxt::get_attr`; the local parser inspects `meta_item_list`/`as_deref`, returns `Bound::Included` for valid integer literals, and reports malformed attributes via `TyCtxt::dcx().span_delayed_bug`.
Attempts to lift a value into the global type context by calling `Lift::lift_to_tcx` on the input.

Builds and returns a fully initialized `GlobalCtxt` by parsing the target data layout, creating interner/common type/lifetime/const tables, cloning profiling state, and initializing caches and allocation state. Calls `parse_data_layout`, `dcx`, `emit_fatal`, `new`, `clone`, and `default`.
Delegates to the session’s optimization hint logic, supplying the local crate name and the provided message thunk. Calls `crate_name`.
Returns the language-items table for the current compilation context by querying it. Calls `get_lang_items`.
Looks up a diagnostic item definition id by symbol name from the global diagnostic-items map. Calls `all_diagnostic_items`.
Looks up the diagnostic item symbol for a definition id from the crate-local diagnostic-items map. Calls `diagnostic_items`.
Checks whether a given definition id is registered under the specified diagnostic-item name in its crate. Calls `diagnostic_items`.
Returns whether the given definition has coroutine kind information. Calls `coroutine_kind`.
Returns the movability of a coroutine definition, panicking if the definition is not a coroutine. Calls `coroutine_kind`.
Checks whether the coroutine is an async desugaring. Calls `coroutine_kind`.
Checks whether the coroutine kind is a general coroutine rather than a desugared async/gen form. Calls `coroutine_kind`.
Checks whether the coroutine is a generator (`gen`) desugaring. Calls `coroutine_kind`.
Checks whether the coroutine is an async generator desugaring. Calls `coroutine_kind`.
Returns the compiler stability index for the current crate. Calls `stability_index`.
Returns the enabled feature set for the current compilation. Calls `features_query`.

Returns the `DefKey` for a definition by converting the query parameter and dispatching to local definitions storage or the crate store depending on locality. Calls `into_query_param`, `definitions_untracked`, and `cstore_untracked`.
Returns the `DefPath` for a definition by reading from local definitions storage for local ids and from the crate store for external ids. Calls `definitions_untracked` and `cstore_untracked`.
Returns the stable `DefPathHash` for a definition, using local definitions storage for local ids and the crate store for external ids. Calls `definitions_untracked` and `cstore_untracked`.
Returns the list of output crate types stored in the global context.
Computes the strongest metadata emission requirement implied by the configured crate types. Calls `crate_types`.
Returns whether this compilation must emit metadata. Calls `metadata_kind`.
Determines whether a crate hash is required, based on debug assertions, incremental compilation, metadata emission, or coverage instrumentation. Calls `needs_metadata` and `instrument_coverage`.
Returns the stable crate id for a crate number, using the local cached id for `LOCAL_CRATE` and the crate store for upstream crates. Calls `cstore_untracked`.
Maps a stable crate id back to a crate number, returning `LOCAL_CRATE` for the local id and otherwise delegating to the crate store. Calls `stable_crate_id` and `cstore_untracked`.

Resolves a `DefPathHash` to a `DefId`, using local definitions for hashes from the local crate and the crate store for upstream hashes. Calls `stable_crate_id`, `cstore_untracked`, and `stable_crate_id_to_crate_num`.

Builds a human-readable debug string containing the crate name, abbreviated stable crate id, and verbose def path, avoiding query recursion by using direct local or crate-store access. Calls `crate_name`, `stable_crate_id`, `cstore_untracked`, and `def_path`.
Returns the diagnostic context from the session.

Creates a new local definition in a query-tracked context, first recording a dependency on the forever-red node, then creating the def, obtaining a feed for it, and assigning the current span. Calls `create_def`, `feed_local_def_id`, and `def_span`.

Creates a new local definition entry in the definitions table, records its kind, and assigns restricted visibility for closures and opaque types based on the parent module. Calls `def_path_data`, `feed_local_def_id`, `def_kind`, `parent_module_from_def_id`, and `visibility`.

Returns an iterator over all local definition ids, tracking the forever-red node, repeatedly reading the current number of definitions so newly created ids are included, and freezing definitions after iteration completes. Calls `read_index` and `freeze`.
Returns the frozen local `DefPathTable`, first recording a dependency on the forever-red node so changes in definition count cause re-execution. Calls `read_index` and `freeze`.

Ensures the HIR crate is loaded before freezing the local definitions table and returning its def-path-hash to def-index map. Calls `ensure`, `hir_crate`, `freeze`, and the underlying `def_path_hash_to_def_index_map`.
Returns an untracked frozen read guard to the crate store by reading `self.untracked.cstore` and remapping the guard to the dyn trait object. Calls `read` and `map`.
Returns a shared reference to the untracked compiler context payload stored in `TyCtxt`.
Returns an untracked read guard for the definitions table by calling `read` on `self.untracked.definitions`.
Looks up a local definition’s source span in the untracked span map and falls back to `DUMMY_SP` if absent. Calls `get` and `unwrap_or`.
Constructs a `StableHashingContext` from the session and untracked state, then invokes the supplied closure with it. Calls `StableHashingContext::new` and the closure `f`.
Serializes the on-disk query result cache if it exists, otherwise returns `Ok(0)`. Calls `as_ref`, `map_or`, and cache `serialize`.
Determines whether the local crate exports generics by scanning crate output types and returning true for `Dylib` or `Rlib`. Calls `share_generics`, `crate_types`, `iter`, and `any`.

Checks whether a region is a diagnosable free region, remaps opaque-type synthetic lifetimes back to their originating function lifetime, computes a named bound region, and marks whether it belongs to a trait impl item. Calls `kind`, `get_id`, `as_local`, `expect_local`, `local_parent`, `def_kind`, `map_rpit_lifetime_to_fn_lifetime`, `item_name`, `opt_hir_node_by_def_id`, and `is_bound_region_in_impl_item`.

Collects `impl Trait` or `dyn Trait` occurrences from a function’s explicit return type HIR, returning an empty vector when no return type node is available. Calls `local_def_id_to_hir_id`, `hir`, `fn_decl_by_hir_id`, and `visit_ty`.

If a function returns a local type alias, visits the alias type to collect contained `impl Trait` or `dyn Trait` uses and returns them together with the alias generics span information. Calls `local_def_id_to_hir_id`, `hir`, `fn_decl_by_hir_id`, `as_local`, `hir_node_by_def_id`, `alias_ty`, `generics`, `visit_ty`, `is_empty`, and `span_for_lifetime_suggestion`.

Returns whether the given impl item belongs to a trait impl, which makes its bound region unsuitable for certain signature-changing diagnostics. Calls `parent`, `to_def_id`, `impl_trait_ref`, and `is_some`.
Reports whether the target architecture uses strict asm symbol naming, currently by checking whether the architecture string contains `"nvptx"`. Calls `contains`.
Builds the `&'static core::panic::Location<'static>` type used for caller-location intrinsics. Calls `require_lang_item`, `type_of`, `mk_args`, `instantiate`, and `Ty::new_imm_ref`.
Returns the grammatical article and human-readable description for a definition by first querying its kind. Calls `def_kind`, `def_kind_descr_article`, and `def_kind_descr`.
Returns the configured type-length limit from the compiler limits query. Calls `limits`.
Returns the configured recursion limit from the compiler limits query. Calls `limits`.
Returns the configured move-size limit from the compiler limits query. Calls `limits`.
Iterates over all trait definition IDs in the local crate and every upstream crate. Calls `crates` and `traits`, using iterator adapters `once`, `chain`, `iter`, `copied`, and `flat_map`.
Returns the local visibility of a definition by querying `visibility` and asserting the result is local with `expect_local`. Calls `visibility` and `expect_local`.
Returns the HIR origin of a local opaque type by looking up the item and extracting its opaque-ty metadata. Calls `hir`, `expect_item`, and `expect_opaque_ty`.

Computes debug statistics for interned types by iterating over all type interner shards, classifying each non-primitive/non-error type variant, counting inference-flag usage, and formatting the report. Calls `lock_shards`, `keys`, and `intersects`.
Returns a debug-printable wrapper around `TyCtxt` that formats interner statistics when printed; the actual formatting logic is delegated to `DebugStats::fmt`.

Formats detailed interner statistics: it invokes the generated type-stat printer and then prints lengths of the generic-args, region, const-allocation, and layout interners. Calls the generated stats formatter from `sty_debug_print!` and `len` on the interners.
Creates a shallow copy of `InternedInSet` by rewrapping the same interned pointer; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Converts the wrapped interned value pointer into an erased `*const ()` for pointer-based identity; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Returns a shared reference to the underlying `internee` inside `WithCachedTypeInfo`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Compares two interned cached values by equality of their underlying `internee`, preserving `Borrow` consistency; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Macro-generated borrow helper that returns a shared reference to the wrapped value `self.0`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Macro-generated hash implementation that hashes the wrapped interned value directly, matching the borrowed view; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Converts a safe function signature into an unsafe function-pointer type after asserting the input signature is safe. It calls `map_bound` to rewrite the bound `FnSig` and `new_fn_ptr` to build the resulting `Ty`.

Checks whether a trait or any of its supertraits may define an associated item with the given name, using unhygienic name filtering plus hygienic identifier comparison. It calls `super_traits_of` from the Methods List.
Returns `true` when a type is an opaque alias whose explicit bounds include a positive `Future` trait bound; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Traverses a trait’s transitive supertraits with a stack and visited set, yielding each reachable trait `DefId` once; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Transforms a closure-like signature whose first input is a tuple of arguments into a normal Rust function signature with the requested unsafety. It calls `mk_fn_sig` to construct the rewritten signature.
Interns a bound `PredicateKind` into a canonical `Predicate` using the type context’s predicate interner; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Interns a `Ty` from a `TyKind` through the context’s type interner; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Constructs a generic argument corresponding to a generic parameter definition by creating the appropriate lifetime, type, or const parameter representation; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Appends a field projection to a MIR place. It calls `mk_place_elem` from the Methods List with `PlaceElem::Field`.

Collects clauses from an iterator and interns them into a canonical clause list. It calls `collect_and_apply` and `mk_clauses`.

Collects MIR place elements from an iterator and interns them as a list. It calls `collect_and_apply` and `mk_place_elems`.

Looks up the trait candidates in scope for a HIR id by querying the owner’s trait map and indexing by local id. It calls `in_scope_traits_map`.

Determines whether a function is usable as `const`, including feature-gate checks for const-unstable items. It calls `is_const_fn_raw`, `lookup_const_stability`, and, for unstable const items, inspects `features().declared_lib_features.iter().any(...)`.
Checks whether a local impl is a const trait impl by inspecting its HIR generics for a host-effect const parameter. It calls `as_local` and `hir_node_by_def_id`.
Reports whether the next trait solver is enabled globally in unstable options by reading the session setting via `map_or`.
Reports whether the next trait solver is enabled for coherence checking in unstable options by reading the session setting via `map_or`.
Checks whether a definition corresponds to impl-trait-in-trait by testing for RPITIT metadata. It calls `opt_rpitit_info`.
Returns the locally resolved children of a module, or an empty slice if none were recorded. It calls `resolutions`.

Forwards the interner hook to `TyCtxt::generics_of`, returning the generics metadata for the given `DefId`. Calls `generics_of`.

Classifies an alias type by inspecting the definition kind of the alias and, for associated types, the parent item to distinguish inherent from projection aliases. Calls `def_kind` and `parent`.

Classifies an alias term into the appropriate alias-term category based on the alias `DefKind`, using the parent definition to distinguish inherent vs trait-associated types. Calls `def_kind` and `parent`.

Reconstructs the trait reference for an associated type/const alias and splits off the alias’s own item arguments from the full argument list. Calls `def_kind`, `parent`, `generics_of`, `new`, `truncate_to`, and `count`.
Forwards to `TyCtxt::mk_args` to intern a slice of generic arguments as a canonical argument list. Calls `mk_args`.
Forwards to `TyCtxt::mk_args_from_iter` to intern generic arguments produced by an iterator. Calls `mk_args_from_iter`.
Forwards to `TyCtxt::check_and_mk_args`, validating generic-argument compatibility for the target item before interning the resulting argument list. Calls `check_and_mk_args`.
Forwards the interner hook to `TyCtxt::parent`, returning the parent definition of the given item. Calls `parent`.
Returns the configured recursion limit as a plain `usize` by reading the compiler recursion-limit setting. Calls `recursion_limit`.
Checks whether the ABI value is the Rust ABI variant. It does not call other listed methods.
Checks whether the HIR safety enum denotes a safe item. It does not call other listed methods.
Forwards to `hir::Safety::prefix_str` to obtain the textual safety prefix. Calls `prefix_str`.

Interns a slice of clauses, returning a shared empty list for the empty case and otherwise computing cached flags and allocating/inserting an interned clause list. Calls `is_empty`, `empty`, `intern_ref`, `for_clauses`, `from_arena`, and `into`.
Implements debug formatting for `Feed` by delegating formatting to the stored key. Calls `fmt`.
Creates the crate’s local `DefId` feed by pushing the crate span into untracked source-span storage and asserting it matches `CRATE_DEF_ID`. Calls `untracked` and `push`.
Converts a `TyCtxtFeed` into a context-free `Feed` by preserving only the key. It does not call other listed methods.
Returns the stored feed key. It does not call other listed methods.
Reattaches a context-free `Feed` to a `TyCtxt`, producing a `TyCtxtFeed` with the same key. It does not call other listed methods.
Builds a `TyCtxtFeed` for the corresponding `hir::OwnerId` from a local definition feed. It does not call other listed methods.

Synthesizes minimal HIR ownership data for a local definition: maps the local def-id to an owner `HirId`, computes owner-node hashing, allocates owner nodes, stores them, and feeds empty attributes for the owner. Calls `local_def_id_to_hir_id`, `make_owner`, `def_id`, `hash_owner_nodes`, `into`, `opt_hir_owner_nodes`, `alloc`, `from_elem_n`, `feed_owner_id`, and `hir_attrs`.
Constructs an empty `CurrentGcx` wrapper backed by an `Lrc<RwLock<Option<_>>>`. Calls `new`.

Provides read-locked access to the current global context, obtains the stored pointer under the lock, and invokes the supplied closure while the lock keeps the context alive. Calls `read`, `unwrap`, and the closure `f`.

Determines whether a local definition has type-checking results by redirecting closures to their typeck root and otherwise checking whether the HIR node owns a body. Calls `typeck_root_def_id`, `to_def_id`, `has_typeck_results`, `expect_local`, `hir_node_by_def_id`, `body_id`, and `is_some`.
Looks up the `Ordering` lang item and returns its concrete type after removing bound vars. Calls `require_lang_item`, `type_of`, `no_bound_vars`, and `unwrap`.

Allocates a new crate number for a stable crate id unless one already exists, checking the read-locked map first and then inserting the new number under a write lock. Calls `untracked`, `read`, `get`, `new`, `len`, `write`, and `insert`.

Attempts to lift an interned value into the target `TyCtxt` by verifying that its backing pointer belongs to the destination interner set, then transmuting the lifetime when valid. Calls `_intern_set_ty_from_interned_ty`, `_type_eq`, `contains_pointer_to`, `then`, and `transmute`.
Type-level helper used only to infer the corresponding interned-set type from an interned value; it is unreachable at runtime. It does not call other listed methods.

Lifts a slice into the target `TyCtxt` if it is empty or allocated in the tcx dropless arena. It calls `is_empty` and, for non-empty slices, `contains_slice` to validate arena ownership before returning the lifted slice.
Returns the interned list contents as a slice borrow for lookup/comparison purposes. It does not call other listed methods.
Compares two interned list wrappers by slice equality so `PartialEq` matches the `Borrow<[T]>` view. It does not call other listed methods.
Hashes the interned list by hashing its slice contents, keeping hashing consistent with the `Borrow<[T]>` representation. It does not call other listed methods.
Public wrapper that checks whether generic arguments match a definition’s generic parameter structure. It directly calls `check_args_compatible_inner` with `nested = false`.

Collects an iterator of `LocalDefId` values and interns them into a `List`. It calls `collect_and_apply`, which invokes `mk_local_def_ids` on the collected elements.
